heading: Governance
sub: How Pioneer Technical Institute is led and held accountable.
seo_title: Governance — Pioneer Technical Institute, Iganga Uganda
seo_description: Learn about the leadership and governance structure of Pioneer Technical Institute (PTI), a registered private TVET provider in Iganga, Uganda.
seo_keywords: Pioneer Technical Institute governance, PTI leadership, TVET governance Uganda

sections.heading: Leadership Structure
sections.body: Pioneer Technical Institute is led by a Director responsible for day-to-day operations, supported by Heads of Department for each faculty (Engineering, Business, Hospitality, Technology, Agriculture, and Early Childhood Education), who oversee curriculum, trainee welfare, and production-unit standards.

sections.heading: Accountability
sections.body: PTI operates under registration with the Ministry of Education and Sports as a Private TVET Provider, and aligns its certification with UBTEB and DIT standards. This means the Institute's programmes, examinations, and record-keeping are subject to external oversight, not run informally.

sections.heading: Policies
sections.body: Institutional policy — admissions, discipline, welfare, and academic standards — is documented and reviewed by the Director's office. Trainees and staff can raise concerns through their department heads or directly with the Director.
